title: The last screen of every DeRot reset says: "Nicely done. Notice how you feel now."

copy.threads_text:
The last screen of every DeRot reset says: "Nicely done. Notice how you feel now."

That second line does more than it looks. Noticing the shift makes the next reset easier to say yes to.
